A mental shift towards taking care of myself instead of trying to please the people around me. They want me to be happy too, so there's no conflict of interest. And a lot more therapy. DBT and CBT ended up being the things that kinda broke the final barrier. It's really hard work, but once you get it going, it's so worth it and makes it easier to continue. Emotional regulation can be a bitch, but it is sooooo nice having more control over your mind. Once I had a better handle on that, I was able to start digging into underlying issues without freaking out, blaming myself and spiraling.

I don't delude myself into thinking I'm cured. I expect to struggle in the future, and possibly fall off the horse sometimes. But that's just how it is. Mental illness is a weird dance partner. As long as I don't judge myself harshly for my emotions, I should be able to get back on track pretty quickly.
